title: A Friend Far Away
text:
Maria and Paulo have been friends since they were children. They live on the same street in Lisbon, so they see each other almost every day. Paulo is very funny, and Maria always laughs when he tells a story. They like to walk in the park on Sundays.

Last year, Maria moved to another city for her job. At first, she felt sad, but Paulo called her every week. Now they talk on video calls, and they still meet every few months. Maria says that a good friend is always there, even from far away.
